title: I Left the Pharmacy Review With the Wrong-Name Bag Photo

parts.text: I said my name at 4:22 p.m. and the tech slid a bag with someone else's last name facing the line. The counter card said: VERIFY THE NAME. SHIELD THE BAG. I was fifty, pickup, holding a still of the exposed label. Tech Omar said it was close enough. Close is a word lines use when a last name exists. I left the review with the photo cropped to the mismatch and the card. Corporate retrained the shield. Omar turns bags now. The counter finally looks like a pharmacy, not a roll call. I kept the printout in a folder labeled BORING.

social.description: Verify card, a mismatched label, a retrained shield. Has a pickup ever been close enough?
